_comment: I0 law-enforcement playbook (schema: app/domain/playbook.py). What the Carabinieri / Procura accept from a victim or PI, what the Italian side can send to whom, and the evidence it wants. An Italian authority is neither US nor French: Circle needs the cross-border route (EU freezing order / EIO to France, MLAT to the US) or US counsel. The binding and cross-border instruments are the Procura's (procura.json): the police level here issues LE requests only.
notes: Only the PM (or the police in urgency, subject to validation) orders a sequestro; providers receive the decree from the PM or police, never from the victim. A protocol number or verbale is never a freeze.

carabinieri.station.notes: The receiving office attests the filing and forwards it to the PM (art. 337 co. 4 c.p.p.). The querela is signed by the victim or a special proxy (procuratore speciale).

instrument.notes: Verbale di denuncia-querela (art. 337 c.p.p. formalities): a PI files only as the victim's special proxy.

deadlines.action: File the querela within 3 months of learning of the fact (art. 124 c.p.); whether aggravants make the offence prosecutable ex officio after the Cartabia reform is disputed, so treat the limit as binding.

paths.notes: The receiving office attests the filing and forwards the querela to the PM (art. 337 co. 4 c.p.p.). The Polizia di Stato's online pre-denuncia (a pilot in a few Lazio / Umbria offices) must be formalised in person at a Polizia di Stato office within 48 hours. Aegis advice (inferred, not from these sources): bring the victim's ID and tax code, the narrative, transaction hashes, wallet addresses, exchange names, screenshots, e-mails with full headers and bank movements; the trace report can follow (integrazione di querela); expect a protocol number and verbale, and a PM and RGNR number from the Procura later.

instrument.notes: Decreto di sequestro preventivo (art. 321 c.p.p.): the PM requests and the GIP decrees; in urgency the PM or police seize and the measure must be validated.

deadlines.action: After an urgent seizure by the police, the police send the verbale to the PM within 48 hours (art. 321 co. 3-bis c.p.p.).
The PM requests validation within 48 hours of the seizure (own seizure) or of receiving the police verbale (art. 321 co. 3-bis c.p.p.): a police seizure can therefore take up to 96 hours in all.
The judge decides within 10 days or the seizure lapses.

paths.notes: Notified to the platform, which must block the wallet, prevent transfers and provide KYC. Foreign providers usually need the cross-border route.

instrument.notes: Reg. (EU) 2018/1805 freezing certificate to the provider's EU state (e.g. France for Circle's EU entity). Not for civil proceedings.

deadlines.action: Only when the certificate states that immediate freezing is necessary (Art. 9(3)): the executing authority decides on recognition within 48 hours of receipt. Otherwise no fixed limit, only 'without delay' (Art. 9(1)): tick immediate freezing for live funds.

The executing authority takes the concrete freezing measures within 48 hours of the recognition decision (Art. 9(4)), whether or not immediate freezing was certified; only the 48-hour recognition limit depends on that (Art. 9(3)).

instrument.notes: US-Italy MLAT through the Ministry of Justice.

paths.notes: About 10 months on average in 2013-14 data (old): pair it with a faster route while funds are live.

issues.by: the police / PM of the case
issues.notes: Tether reportedly accepts requests from agencies of many countries (reported, medium); Circle does not act on an Italian request.
